It was making noises from the engine as a 30 y.o. Plane and shaking at every cloud. The toilets were not clean, the staff is friendly but never checked the belts, seats, etc It was a scary flight!!!

reviews.title: Terrible airway, stay away at all cost!
reviews.text: Our flights got canceled both ways, we only received a last moment notification which went to spam. There were no reasonable alternative. A lot of stress, extra costs, sleepless nights... Our friend's flight in a different direction got rescheduled to 2 am instead of 10 am. It seems to happen way too often with this airway, don't take a risk.
reviews.author: Dina S

reviews.title: The worst Customer Experience I've ever had.
reviews.text: The flight out of Yerevan was delayed by 1hr30 with no reason given. 5 of us missed our connection (still with FlyOne) to Luton. Everyone from the airline had gone home. We had to stay in the airport overnight & arrange our own onward travel as the next flight was in 2 days. We were told we'd be refunded, but after six weeks, numerous emails & numerous overseas phone calls I haven't got a penny back. I've been told the flight wasn't delayed and that I was lying. I've been told, in order to qualify for a refund, I needed to put the refund request in whilst I was up all night in the airport trying frantically to get home, not 2 days later. Every person I've spoken to on their customer support line has either hung up on me or said they'll ring me back but not a single person has. I can't stress enough how bad this experience was. Fly with literally anyone else. Walking across the continent on my hands would have been a more pleasant experience.
reviews.author: Stewart N

reviews.title: How this Airline Scams
reviews.text: They are scamming you. You will check in online and they will force you to pay 15 euros to checkin online - however after paying online they will tell you online checkin is not available for flight - which means not only did they steal 15 euros but they will now take another 30 euros to checkin in person

reviews.title: Complete  scam/AVOID AT ALL COSTS/NO CUSTOMER SERVICE/IF I COULD GIVE IT A 0
reviews.text: Check in online wasn't working before the flight, tried in the evening, at midnight, next morning - still the same thing. Called, there was no answer, wrote on FB to two different accounts, no answer until next day, 3 hours before the flight they respond with checkin online already closed. Sent them screenshots of their website not working - there was no answer from CS rep :D got completely ignored. Got to the airport, paid for check in in the airport. Got the receipt, took a picture. Sent one email right away. No answer. Sent a second email. No answer still. 12 days passed, they are completely ignoring it and apparently for them it is worth ruining your reputation for 70 euros :) Food delivery services in Moldova have better websites than FLYONE who is apparently only caring about getting all the money in the world in their pockets and doesn't want to hire a decent specialist to get their website up and running normally.

reviews.title: Typical post-soviet scammers
reviews.text: Booked for a flight, before the flight I've checked if I can reschedule the flight date. The personal account showed me, that the flight is rescheduled already for unknown date, so I was given the options to wait for the updated date, money refund or get a voucher of a ticket's value plus 10%. I've chosen the voucher. Got a cancelation approval, but no voucher. Contacted the costumer's care, and was told that the flight is not rescheduled and I just cancelled the booking without any benefits. I've asked to restore the original booking and got no answer at all. Keep away of that scammers.

reviews.title: An Outrageous Experience with FLYONE - Deplorable Customer Service
reviews.text: I am ordinarily not one to write negative reviews, but my recent experience with FLYONE Airlines leaves me no other choices. The hope is that by sharing this, potential customers might be separated the frustration and financial losses I faced. Let me paint a picture of a situation you'd never want to find yourself in. I was due to fly, in the hopes of seeing my ailing father who was in intense therapy in a hospital. One would hope that amidst such emotional turmoil, a simple process like catching a flight would be straightforward. How gravely mistaken I was. FLYONE's flight was delayed. These things happen, I understand. But when the unexpected strikes, isn't that when a company's service should truly shine? Instead, I one answering the call, their system proved to be so obsolete and unsympathetic, that it refused to allow me to re-register for a new flight. In my hour of need, stranded and desperate, I was forced to buy an entirely new ticket just to reach my destination. One might argue that unforeseen problems can occur. However, what is utterly indefensible is the fact that I have spent a full month attempting to get my money refunded, with my pleas falling on deaf ears. Each passing day reiterates the fact that FLYONE does not care about their customers, that they are only interested in their bottom line. Not a shred of humanity, empathy, or decency has been displayed in their communication. For a company that claims to put its customers first, their actions speak louder
reviews.author: SERGIOS

reviews.title: Beware - Fraud!!
reviews.text: The same thing happened to me like in the all the previous negative reviews. Flyone cancelled my flight, rescheduling it to another flight 3 days later. They took my money and didn't refund me. I have contacted them numerous times, but they do not answer. Nothing at all. Reading these previous reviews, it seems like the same, common scam they are doing. I just can't believe this company is allowed to stay in business. They need to be closed down and legally prosecuted.

reviews.title: AVOID THIS COMPANY
reviews.text: Flyone changed my flights several times, before interchanging my flights between Moscow and Erevan and Erevan in Tbilisi, which made me lose the connection. I had to buy another flight in last minute. Same scenario for my return flight : my flight from Erevan to Moscow was delayed (more than 12h), so I had to buy another flight for my return. It's been now a MONTH that I'm writing to the company to obtain a refund, which I'm fully entitled to according to their terms: I got no answer, and of course no refund. I dont think they even process the request they receive. It's an under-developed company made of dishonest thieves, which is here only to steal great amounts of money (almost 600 euros in my case) and make us lose time.

reviews.title: Worst experience ever!!!
reviews.text: I have never had such a bad experience of travelling like with this company! I had 5 flights with them in total (2 way travel). All of them were delayed! Not a single one flew on time. And I am not talking about one hour delays! One of the flights was delayed by 9 hours!!! One of the planes was that old that I was stressed during 3 hours of my travel! have never seen a plane like that in my entire life although I travel all the time!!! To avoid at al cost!!!

I requested a refund as it is absolutely unaccaptable schedule for me. They haven't refund me anything. I tried to contact them via email, contact us form, facebook - no answer at all, just ingoring me.
reviews.author: Andrei Shirmanov

reviews.title: 15 HOURS DELAY WITH NO REFUND WHATSOEVER!
reviews.text: I have never ever flew with such a bad a company in my life. Like for real. I bought a ticket to a flight which was 3 hours prior to departure and I could not check-in online because the online check-in ends 4 hours prior to departure! I tried explaining this to the manager (the most rude female I have ever met) but she was just smirking and telling me that I will not fly without paying the 30€ fee!! I wish that would have been the end of it. No... the flight had a 15 hours delay!! You can not even write a proper complaint because the only way to ask for a refund or a compensation is through their website form and you never receive a confirmation per email of your request. It is like they just delete your inquiries right away. I tried calling them and the brain-dead receptionist just told me: "we have no complaint registered from you". Just like that, plain and simple. Every company has flight delays, it is unavoidable, but the way Flyone deals with customers is just criminal. They should rename the company to Fly Once and never again!
